@@U03294@@
The poet makes use of her however he likes. She never grows up, never grows old, is forever appetizing; abducted as a girl, she’s courted in her senility. Poets aren't bound by time.

@@U03296@@
Then neither will she be bound by time! 阿喀琉斯, himself outside of time, found and made her his own on Pherae. What rare fortune, to wrest from fate one’s own true love! Why, then, shouldn't I, with my fierce longing, bring back to life this one and only form? This deathless being, the equal of gods by her birth, as great as she is tender, sublime as she is lovable? You saw her once long ago, but I saw her today: a vision of loveliness, charm and desire. My mind and soul are possessed, my entire being! Without her, life is not possible.

@@U03298@@
My poor man, what an odd case you present! Humans would say you're in a state of rapture. We spirits find you really quite deranged. But you're in luck, I’m happy to say. Once each year, very briefly, I visit 曼托, 阿斯克勒庇俄斯’ daughter. In silent prayer she beseeches her father, for his own honor’s sake, at last to shed some light on physicians’ minds, and convert them from their reckless slaughter. She’s a favorite of mine of all the Sibyls’ guild. Nothing grotesque here, only kindness, concern and gentle good works.
translation:
@@U03294@@
诗人随心所欲地利用她。她永远不会长大，永远不会变老，永远令人胃口大开；当她还是个女孩的时候就被绑架了，她在年老的时候就受到了追求。诗人不受时间的限制。

@@U03296@@
那么她也不会被时间所束缚！ 时间之外的阿喀琉斯在费莱发现了她并将她据为己有。能从命运中夺取自己的真爱，是多么难得的幸运啊！那么，我为什么不应该怀着强烈的渴望，让这唯一的形式复活呢？这个不死的存在，与生俱来与神平等，伟大而温柔，崇高而可爱？你很久以前见过她一次，但我今天看到了她：一种可爱、魅力和欲望的景象。我的思想和灵魂被附身了，我的整个存在！没有她，生活就不可能。

@@U03298@@
我可怜的人，你提出的情况多么奇怪啊！人们会说你处于狂喜的状态。我们的灵魂发现你真的很精神错乱。但我很高兴地说，你很幸运。每年，我都会短暂地拜访阿斯克勒庇俄斯的女儿曼托。在默默的祈祷中，她恳求她的父亲，为了他自己的荣誉，最终阐明医生的思想，使他们摆脱鲁莽的屠杀。她是所有女预言家公会中我最喜欢的一个。这里没有什么怪诞的，只有善良、关心和温柔的善行。
